_comment: Operator-owned content-decode policy. Edit this file to change what the agent is allowed to decode. The agent will not decode any class without this file being present and valid.
note: Operator takes full legal responsibility under Israeli law (Communications Law 5742-1982 and subordinate regulations). This configuration enables decoding of all listed classes including voice communications received off-the-air. No content is published or transmitted; all decoded material is stored locally and used only for spectrum-intelligence research and analysis.
